'''Bitsy''' was a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] [[LRRL-75 rocket launcher|LRRL-75]] [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]] owned by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Corso Riggs]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bitsy was first mentioned in Corso Riggs's entry in the [[2012]] reference guide, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
